note: Bridger-Teton NF campground above Lower Green River Lake at 8,000 ft, under Square Top Mountain at the north end of the Wind River Range, about 50 mi north of Pinedale; the last 18 mi are dirt (WY-352, then FR 370600 and Green River Lakes Road FR 370650). The road is passable in 2WD when dry, but weather can make it impassable to all but 4WD - call the Pinedale Ranger District for conditions. Water was reported off in 2026 after Dollar Lake Fire (2025) damage; check before going. Trailhead, horse corral and carry-down boat launch nearby. --Claude
